name: Shadow (BB)

source.title: Pathfinder Beginner Box: Secrets of the Unlit Star

items.name: Incorporeal
items.text: A shadow has no body and can pass through physical objects, though it can't end its turn inside one. Most checks that use Strength and require a body, such as Grapple and Shove, don't work against a shadow, and a shadow can't use them.

items.name: Light Vulnerability
items.text: Attacks against the shadow are treated as magical if the shadow or the weapon being used is in light.

items.name: Slink in Shadows
items.text: The shadow can Hide or end its Sneak in a creature's or object's shadow.

items.name: Steal Shadow
items.text: If the shadow hits a living creature with a Strike on its previous action, it can use this action to pull at the target's shadow, imposing a –1 status penalty to Athletics and to attack rolls and damage rolls that use Strength (Enfeebled 1). The penalty increases each time a shadow uses this ability to a maximum of –4. The penalty decreases by 1 every hour.

text: Undead shadows feed on those who stray from the light.
